# Checkpoint and Impinj Extend Inventory Visibility to Liquid Products with Gen2X


- Checkpoint SmartShrinkTM RFID inlays with Impinj Gen2X® cut time required to inventory 100% of liquid products by more than 50% in handheld inventory testing
- In stationary inventory testing from one meter, Gen2X read 89% of tagged liquid products in five seconds, compared with 74% using Gen2
- Testing showed Gen2X consistently improved inventory accuracy across multiple read distances


****


Liquid products have historically created challenges for RAIN RFID inventory systems, as they absorb radio energy and are often packaged in curved containers or displayed on metal shelves that can affect RF performance. Yet retailer adoption of RAIN RFID is rapidly growing across health and beauty, food, and other general merchandise categories, making accurate and timely inventory visibility for these products increasingly important.


Checkpoint Systems and Impinj are addressing this challenge with Checkpoint SmartShrink, a purpose-built RFID tagging solution powered by Impinj M800 series ICs with Gen2X support. SmartShrink innovatively positions the RFID inlay on the bottle cap to help address the challenges liquids can create for RFID performance, while M800 and Gen2X enhance read performance to improve inventory speed and accuracy.


In testing with liquid products and an[E Family handheld reader with support for Gen2X](https://www.impinj.com/partners?query=&pageSize=24&partnerProfile=ProductTypes.Handheld%2520Reader%2CHasGen2XSupport.true) , SmartShrink with Gen2X support cut the time required to inventory 100% of products by more than half at close range. In stationary testing at a one-meter distance, Gen2X also improved the percentage of tagged items read in five seconds from 74% to 89%.


### Purpose-Built for Inventorying Liquid Products


Checkpoint developed SmartShrink specifically for liquid-filled containers. Applied during the filling and capping process, the solution integrates RFID directly into a shrink band positioned on the bottle cap, helping manufacturers add an RFID tag without requiring a label redesign.


****


SmartShrink bands can be applied to a wide range of products spanning categories including health and beauty, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, home care and home improvement, garden, and automotive products. Checkpoint’s use of Impinj M800 series endpoint ICs enables support for Gen2X, which improves read performance across small tags, liquids and metals, and dense product packing common in retail environments.


### Faster, More Accurate Inventory with Gen2X


To quantify Gen2X performance improvements, Checkpoint tested around 50 one-gallon liquid containers equipped with M800 series-powered SmartShrink inlays using an E Family handheld reader with Gen2X support.


Gen2X reduced the time required to inventory the containers by 52%, from 10.6 seconds with Gen2 to 5.1 seconds with Gen2X. Faster inventory matters to retailers: It can reduce the time required for handheld stock checks and the amount of time retail employees need to hold a reader in one position.


The performance improvements extended beyond close-range scanning. During a five-second stationary test at a one-meter distance, Gen2X read 89% of tagged items, compared with 74% using Gen2.


****


These results demonstrate how Checkpoint's SmartShrink design and Impinj Gen2X can work together to improve the speed and accuracy of inventorying liquid products, helping retailers extend reliable item-level visibility across more of their merchandise.


### Extending Physical Intelligence to More Products


As retailers automate more operations and increasingly rely on AI-powered enterprise systems, accurate and timely data about physical items becomes even more valuable. Extending reliable inventory visibility to traditionally challenging products such as liquids can provide a more complete picture of what is happening across physical operations.


Gen2X is a key enabler of Impinj Physical Intelligence, enhancing RAIN RFID reading performance to help businesses connect more information about physical items to enterprise systems. For retailers, more complete item-level data can support more accurate inventory, improved shelf availability, faster replenishment, and fewer inventory blind spots.


“Combining our innovative SmartShrink inlay design with the performance of Gen2X-enabled Impinj M800 series endpoints is enabling retailers to reliably and efficiently inventory traditionally difficult-to-tag liquid containers,” said Louis Parker, RFID Market Development Manager for Checkpoint Systems. “SmartShrink makes retail mandate compliance and inventory visibility simple, scalable, and disruption-free, especially for the products that need it most.”


As[retailers including Walmart](https://www.impinj.com/library/blog/what-walmart-suppliers-should-know-about-tagging-t) expand the use of RAIN RFID across additional product categories, suppliers increasingly need solutions that extend reliable item-level inventory visibility to a broader range of products.


By combining Checkpoint's purpose-built SmartShrink design with Impinj M800 series endpoint ICs and Gen2X, manufacturers and retailers can extend accurate inventory visibility to more physical items, helping automate inventory processes, improve shelf availability, and providing enterprise systems with more complete real-world data.
